description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling ConnectionClosed events within a connectivity messaging persistence layer. It updates the status of a Connection object to CLOSED upon receiving the event.

classes.name: ConnectionClosedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements the EventStrategy interface to handle ConnectionClosed events by updating the connection status to CLOSED.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the ConnectionClosed event by verifying the connection is not null and then updating its status to CLOSED.
